Markets.title: India’s IPO fundraising poised to breach Rs 1 lakh crore in 2026
Markets.summary: Indian IPO fundraising is projected to exceed one lakh crore rupees in 2026, driven by high valuations and strong domestic investor demand. Upcoming offerings from the National Stock Exchange and Jio Platforms are expected to significantly boost these total collections.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as rising oil, Treasury yields lift Fed hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks ended lower as Brent crude surged to $107 a barrel and Treasury yields climbed to multi-year highs. These rising energy prices and inflation data strengthened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week.

Markets.title: Advent, Temasek in talks for Fairfax stake in IIFL Fin
Markets.summary: Advent International and Temasek Holdings are in talks to buy Fairfax Financial's stake in IIFL Finance. Fairfax is selling the stake, valued at about ₹3,500 crore, to comply with regulations and fund its planned acquisition of IDBI Bank.

Markets.title: 'Fintechs must treat data as fiduciary duty, not business asset,' says RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra
Markets.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that fintech companies must treat user data as a fiduciary trust rather than a business asset. He warned that data misuse causes irreversible damage, emphasizing the need for strict consent compliance, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.

Markets.title: US bond yields climb to multi-year highs as oil surge revives bets on higher Fed rates
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields reached multi-year highs, with the 10-year yield approaching 5%. This increase was driven by rising oil prices that renewed inflation concerns and heightened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Oil surges 5%, Brent and US crude both over $100 on more tanker attacks
Markets.summary: Oil prices jumped 5% above $100 a barrel as escalating US-Iran conflict and tanker attacks raised supply disruption fears. This upward pressure was further driven by rising Chinese demand and tighter OPEC output.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly captured the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha. This seizure brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is a vital international shipping route.

Geo-Political.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump's election-year proposal to pay $5,000 to every American adult is being questioned by analysts. Experts doubt whether the financial offer is affordable, legal, or practically workable.

Geo-Political.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
Geo-Political.summary: Flight data shows one pilot warned the other about the Amazon cargo plane's excessive speed before it crashed. Despite the warning and sounding alarms, the crew had an uneven response to the situation.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is suing a newspaper over its report claiming the UAE warned him about the 7 October attack. The newspaper stated it stands by its reporting, which was based on extracts from a new book.

Geo-Political.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
Geo-Political.summary: A fire engulfed two schools in the rebel-held city of Bukavu in the eastern DR Congo. More than 20 children were killed during the resulting stampede as students tried to flee the flames.

Geo-Political.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
Geo-Political.summary: A man in a French village near Toulouse was jailed for threatening to behead his son's female primary school teacher. The father made the death threats against the teacher following a dispute regarding his child.

AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is emerging as a new method for generating organic traffic compared to traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: Vladimir Putin lands in New Delhi: What's on the Russian President's agenda ahead of BRICS Summit?
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is arriving in New Delhi on Friday for crucial bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Their discussions will focus on strategic trade, payment mechanisms, energy security, and geopolitical conflict-resolution ahead of the BRICS Summit.

Data & Insights.title: States are using a roundabout way to borrow. And that's raising concerns
Data & Insights.summary: State governments are increasingly borrowing money through special purpose vehicles and state corporations. This practice creates a false appearance of fiscal responsibility while hiding the state's true financial liability for the debt.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: Xi Jinping, Putin, Pezeshkian among global leaders attending New Delhi meet – Full list
Data & Insights.summary: Global leaders including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Masoud Pezeshkian are attending the BRICS summit in New Delhi. Originally formed in 2006 by four nations, the alliance now includes eleven major emerging markets and developing countries.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran War shadow over BRICS Summit? Can host India bridge divisions in the Middle East?
Data & Insights.summary: India values West Asia for its energy imports, trade, and large diaspora. A prolonged regional conflict could increase India's import costs, inflation, and economic challenges.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
Data & Insights.summary: India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, marking 20 years since the bloc's founding in 2006. The alliance has now expanded to 11 member nations, which together account for 40% of the global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Diplomacy tightrope, economic heft test await India at Brics summit
Data & Insights.summary: At the upcoming BRICS summit, India aims to advance cooperation on trade, payments, energy security, and supply chains. Simultaneously, New Delhi must delicately balance its diplomatic relations with China, Russia, and the broader Global South.

India.title: Putin Lands In Delhi For BRICS Summit, To Hold Bilateral With PM Modi Today
India.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has arrived in Delhi to attend the BRICS summit. He will hold bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi today, following their recent meeting in Bishkek last week.

India.title: 'Villain, Not Hero': TTV Dhinakaran Attacks Vijay Over 'Broken Jaw' Row
India.summary: Politician TTV Dhinakaran sharply criticized actor-turned-politician Vijay over a controversy involving a "broken jaw" hand gesture. Dhinakaran also attacked the chief minister, labeling him as a self-centred and evil man.

India.title: Delhi Building Collapse: Satya Niketan PG Operator Denied Anticipatory Bail
India.summary: A Delhi court denied the anticipatory bail plea of the PG operator, Tyagi, regarding a building collapse in Satya Niketan. The judge based the decision on submitted evidence and the statement of an injured student.

India.title: CCTV Trail Deepens Odisha Orangutan Mystery, Probe Stretches To Sea Routes
India.summary: Two young orangutans are currently being cared for at a Bhubaneswar zoo while an investigation tracks their smuggling trail using CCTV and sea routes. Authorities are feeding the animals mashed apples and playing classical music to keep them calm during the probe.

India.title: Runaway Drug Smuggler Tries Makeover To Give Cops The Slip, Gets Caught
India.summary: Aqib Bashir, a drug smuggler who escaped from Narcotics Control Bureau custody in Jammu, was re-arrested in Jalandhar, Punjab. Law enforcement agencies captured him during a joint operation despite his attempt to alter his appearance.

India.title: Assam Police Officer Arrested Over Links With Crude Oil Theft Racket
India.summary: An Assam police officer has been arrested for suspected connections to a crude oil theft ring. The officer's involvement was discovered during an investigation into criminals who punctured an ONGC pipeline in Sarupathar to steal oil.

General.title: Labour mayors in England vow to cap tourist tax at 5%
General.summary: Labour mayors in England have announced plans to cap a new visitor overnight tax at 5%. Reform UK and the Conservatives have both criticized the proposed tourism levy.

General.title: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt
General.summary: Twenty-five years after 9/11, the attacks continue to shape global foreign, security, and intelligence policies. Governments are still learning critical lessons from the espionage, strategies, and missed opportunities surrounding the event.

General.title: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
General.summary: The price of oil jumps to $105 a barrel amid signs the Iran war will not be resolved quickly.

General.title: Use all powers necessary on anti-migrant protests, home secretary tells police
General.summary: The home secretary has instructed police to use all necessary powers during anti-migrant protests. This directive follows demonstrations that occurred in Dover and Portsmouth last weekend.

General.title: Ukraine's fortress cities under fire as Russia bids to seize rest of Donbas
General.summary: Kramatorsk and Slovyansk are now the main focus of Russian ground assaults, and residents are being told to leave.

General.title: Can Trump pay $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win midterm elections?
General.summary: President Trump has proposed giving $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win the midterm elections. Financial and legal analysts question whether this proposal is affordable, legal, or practically workable.
